questions.q: At which type of plate boundary does an oceanic plate sink beneath a continental plate?
questions.why: At a destructive boundary the denser oceanic plate is subducted, causing earthquakes and explosive volcanoes.

questions.q: The point on the Earth's surface directly above where an earthquake starts is the
questions.why: The focus is underground; the epicentre is the surface point directly above it.

questions.q: Which scale measures the explosiveness of a volcanic eruption?
questions.why: The VEI (0 to 8) measures eruption size and explosiveness.

questions.q: Explain why earthquakes cause fewer deaths in developed countries than in developing countries.
questions.model: Developed countries have earthquake-resistant buildings, better emergency services, hospitals and warning systems, so fewer people are killed. Developing countries have weaker buildings and less money for rescue and healthcare.
points: better building design / preparation in developed countries
better emergency services / healthcare, more money
